notes: Example only: replace the splat values with the coordinates you read off your scan in SuperSplat. Use 3-5 points that form a triangle, not a straight line. Names must match court landmarks: center_court, east_rim, west_rim, east_free_throw_center, west_free_throw_center, corner_northeast, corner_southeast, corner_northwest, corner_southwest. For a point that isn't on that list (a couch corner in a practice scan), give "court": [x, y, z] in meters instead of a name.
